history.note: Teacher's rule for show-that parts (the exact value's next figure must not be zero), applied on 14 November 2026 at the teacher's request. Recalculated by hand with pA = 2.5 x 10^5 Pa: pC = 7.87 x 10^4 Pa, Q(AB) = 625 J, work on the gas C to A 139 J, net work 111 J, efficiency 0.18 (unchanged). The rounded 7.9 x 10^4 Pa gives 138 J, inside the accepted range. Graph redrawn from the adiabat equation with the pressure axis to 3.0; A and B on the 2.5 gridline. Independent check agrees.
